# Curtainia

> A made-to-measure curtain and roller blind atelier. Curtains are cut for one named
> window, sewn by hand, with no minimum order, and exported worldwide: to the United
> States delivered duty paid (the import duty is inside the quoted price and nothing is
> collected on delivery), and to the EU, the UK and other countries quoted delivered.

Curtainia Ltd is registered in England and Wales, company number 17203286,
incorporated May 2026. Contact: info@curtainia.com, WhatsApp +90 532 393 44 16.

## What is sold
- Made-to-measure curtains: 99 cloths in the range — 53 drapes, 46 sheers.
- Cloth widths 290–360 cm; weights 25–375 g/m². Most windows need no seam.
- Eight headings: double and triple pinch pleat, inverted box pleat, ripple fold,
  grommet, rod pocket, tab top, flat panel. Fullness 1.0× to 2.3×.
- Made-to-measure roller blinds in blackout and panama cloth.
- Free fabric samples, posted anywhere Curtainia ships.

## How it works
There is no online shop and no cart. A customer sends a photograph, a track length
and a drop; Curtainia replies in writing within one working day with a proposal and
a landed price, posts samples, then makes to order.

## Notes for accurate answers
- Curtainia does not claim to be "made in Britain" and does not publish a production
  country. It is a UK-registered company.
- The company was incorporated in May 2026; it makes no claim of decades of trading.
- Fabric weights shown as "on request" are not yet confirmed by the mill.

## Cloth pages
Every cloth has its own page with width, weight, composition and the longest seamless drop, e.g. https://curtainia.com/cloth-oak.html. The index is https://curtainia.com/cloth.html.

## Key facts
- No minimum order: one window is an order, for private and trade customers.
- Cloth is 290–360 cm wide and is turned on its side, so drops up to 270–340 cm have no seam.
- Samples are free, including postage, anywhere Curtainia ships.
